Authorization.description: The strategy's word, split into the market's reason, the safety gates and the governor.
Authorization.title: Authorization

BarsResponse.description: History window (served from G3/G5). ``bars`` are strictly increasing in time.
BarsResponse.title: BarsResponse

ErrorBody.description: Every API error has this shape (never an HTML page, never a bare 503).
ErrorBody.title: ErrorBody

FormingBar.description: The still-open bar of one timeframe (``bar.is_closed`` is False).
FormingBar.title: FormingBar

ForwardFunnel.description: How far the decision chain got at each closed M5 bar (descriptive, no claim).
ForwardFunnel.title: ForwardFunnel

ForwardGap.description: A run of closed M5 bars during which the engine logged nothing (it was down or stuck).
ForwardGap.title: ForwardGap

HumanRecord.description: One decision of the HUMAN, with the system state it answered. Append-only: never edited.
HumanRecord.title: HumanRecord

HumanRequest.description: What the page may send: which candidate (setup_id) and the choice. Never a price or a size.
HumanRequest.title: HumanRequest

M1Execution.description:
Is this a good MOMENT to act on an idea the higher timeframes already support? Timing only:
``direction`` is copied from H1 and M1 can never change it.
M1Execution.title: M1Execution

ModelDetail.description: The ML V0 volatility/range model: status, evidence and locks (never a forecast).
ModelDetail.title: ModelDetail

MtfRow.description: One timeframe's role and verdict in the chain (H4 regime ... M1 execution).
MtfRow.title: MtfRow

PaperPositionView.description: One PAPER position (open or closed). Nothing here ever reached a broker.
PaperPositionView.title: PaperPositionView

QuoteResponse.description: Latest quote from the collector's live file (read-only).
QuoteResponse.title: QuoteResponse

Readiness.description: Deterministic lifecycle, lowest to highest (spec section 9). NOT probabilities.
Readiness.title: Readiness

RiskInfo.description: Risk of a plan, cost known or explicitly unknown (never silently zero).
RiskInfo.title: RiskInfo

StateSnapshot.description: The one decision surface the page renders (WAIT/BUY/SELL/HOLD/EXIT/UNAVAILABLE).
StateSnapshot.title: StateSnapshot

SymbolInfo.description: Broker contract specification (measured by the collector, never hard-coded).
SymbolInfo.title: SymbolInfo

SystemAdvice.description: The SYSTEM layer: an advisory recommendation, never a command. The human decides.
SystemAdvice.title: SystemAdvice

TicksResponse.description: Ticks in ``[from, to)`` ordered by millisecond time (read-only; for the cost model).
TicksResponse.title: TicksResponse

TradePlan.description: Entry/SL/TP of a valid plan (served from G4 on; not produced by the G2 skeleton).
TradePlan.title: TradePlan

FormingBar.description: The still-open bar of one timeframe (``bar.is_closed`` is False).
FormingBar.title: FormingBar

QuoteResponse.description: Latest quote from the collector's live file (read-only).
QuoteResponse.title: QuoteResponse

WsEvent.description: Server push. ``seq`` increases by one per event so a client detects a gap and refetches.
WsEvent.title: WsEvent

post.description: Record the human's choice on the CURRENT candidate (and only on it).

get.description: The still-open bar of each timeframe (from the collector's live file).
Ticks in ``[from, to)``, oldest first, at most ``limit`` (``has_more`` when truncated).

post.description: Open a PAPER position from the decision the server computes right now (BUY/SELL only).
Close an open PAPER position at the current quote (bid for a BUY, ask for a SELL).
